verdict.rationale: Compatibility and upgrade guidance is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code CLI, but the evidence pack has no compatibility-promise document and no version upgrade guides. The only nearby items are a mention that v1.7.0 introduced test mocking and community remarks about reaching v1.0. Neither documents a compatibility guarantee or an upgrade path. Terraform tests checking for breaking changes in module configuration concern user modules, not compatibility between Terraform releases.
